userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: No AssignedRight or paid Session covers the vehicle at the place at the observed time.
The nearest AssignedRight or Session covering the vehicle has ended (overstay past the paid/permitted time).
The vehicle's right exists but its validity has not started (early arrival on a reservation or future-dated permit).
The vehicle holds a right for a different HierarchyElement (wrong zone, level, lot, or space).
The stay exceeds the place's maximum-stay operating restriction regardless of payment.
The vehicle occupies a space it is not eligible for (accessible, EV charging, loading, reserved, permit-only).
A permit or credential is presented by a vehicle it was not issued to, or is suspended, cloned, or otherwise invalid.
The vehicle is parked during a period when the place is closed to parking (street cleaning, event closure, tow-away window).
The vehicle obstructs a lane, access, exit, hydrant, or another space.
A violation class not otherwise listed; the notice text carries the specifics.
